13.name: The People's Militia
desc: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters and return to him on Sentinel Hill.
objectives: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters and return to him on Sentinel Hill.
details: A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead. The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior. Dispatch immediately, $n, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.
BThe Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower. As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
completion: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.

37.name: Find the Lost Guards
desc: Guard Thomas wants you to travel north up the river and search for the two lost guards, Rolf and Malakai.
objectives: Guard Thomas wants you to travel north up the river and search for the two lost guards, Rolf and Malakai.
details: A few days ago we sent two Guards, Rolf and Malakai, to investigate along the river, and they have not yet returned. To complete my report, I must know what happened to those men.
BTravel north along the river and find the guards... or their remains.
completion: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.

61.name: Shipment to Stormwind
desc: Bring William's Shipment to Morgan Pestle in the Stormwind Trade District.
objectives: Bring William's Shipment to Morgan Pestle in the Stormwind Trade District.
details: My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles. I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.
BI've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
completion: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around! I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.

85.name: Lost Necklace
desc: Speak with Billy Maclure.
objectives: Speak with Billy Maclure.
details: I lost my necklace, and think that guttersnipe Billy Maclure took it! He's usually scuttling like a rat around the Maclure vineyards east of here.
BGet my necklace back for me, and you'll warm an old widow's heart.
completion: You lost a what? Well I didn't take no necklace, because I ain't no thief!
BI might know who did but...<grin>...I'm too hungry to remember.

109.name: Report to Gryan Stoutmantle
desc: Talk to Gryan Stoutmantle. He usually can be found in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road, in the middle of Westfall.
objectives: Talk to Gryan Stoutmantle. He usually can be found in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road, in the middle of Westfall.
details: Looks to me you've seen quite a bit of combat in your time, $c. If you haven't already, you should report to Gryan Stoutmantle. He heads up the People's Militia, aimed at protecting the farmlands of Westfall. I bet he could use your help. You can usually find him in the stone tower on Sentinel Hill, just off the road in the middle of Westfall.
completion: Ah, so my friend sent you here? How kind.

BWell the Stormwind Monarchy has abandoned our cause. Now it is up to the People's Militia to keep the land free from corruption. If our cause interests you, I can put your combat skills to use in the name of freedom.

133.name: Ghoulish Effigy
desc: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.
objectives: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.
details: I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me! In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!
BI want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls. To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs. You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.
BGet the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
completion: Ah, thanks. These will do just the trick!

157.name: Deliver the Thread
desc: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie, in his shack north of the Raven Hill Cemetery.
objectives: Bring the Ghost Hair Thread to Abercrombie, in his shack north of the Raven Hill Cemetery.
details: Here is your thread, $N. It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
completion: Delightful! This will do splendidly...
BHere, good $N, take this as payment for your honorable deed.

181.name: Look To The Stars
desc: Locate Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and return his monocle to Viktori in Darkshire.
objectives: Locate Zzarc'Vul in the southern ogre mound in Duskwood and return his monocle to Viktori in Darkshire.
details: Now there is just one more item needed to complete this device. Cog's blueprint calls for a lens of some sort. The only lens I know of that would be large enough will be very difficult to acquire.
BThere is an ogre by the name of Zzarc'Vul who resides in the mound in southern Duskwood. If you can, bring to me his monocle and I will use that as our lens!
completion: At last! The stargazing device is complete! Thank you, $N. Now I can continue my research. . .

205.name: Troll Witchery
desc: Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
objectives: Bring 4 Skullsplitter Fetishes to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
details: While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic. Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.
completion: Thank you. I will study these fetishes and see if they hold the secret of Kurzen's fall into evil.

229.name: The Daughter Who Lived
desc: Speak with Watcher Sarah Ladimore in Darkshire.
objectives: Speak with Watcher Sarah Ladimore in Darkshire.
details: I should have told you this earlier...
BHow do I put this...

BMorgan may have believed that his family was all dead, but, in fact, his daughter Sarah Ladimore is now a Watcher. She's always been troubled by the... circumstances... surrounding her father's death. Perhaps you could go to bring the news to her.
completion: Yes? My father...
B<Her eyes become downcast.>
BI wish... there was something I could have done for him... If only I had talked to him before he...

253.name: Bride of the Embalmer
desc: Find Eliza's grave. Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.
objectives: Find Eliza's grave. Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.
details: The Embalmer is a name told in one of our children's stories. He was a kindly alchemist, driven mad by the death of his wife, Eliza. To restore her, he used dark magic to place his own heart within the bosom of his dead spouse.
BThis revived Eliza...but it cursed her with a hunger for human flesh, forcing the Embalmer to keep her buried.
BHis heart is his power. Find his wife's grave, retrieve his heart, and bring it to me while it still beats. Do this and his power will be broken.
completion: You've done it! The magic within his heart will be proof against the Embalmer's evil, and a powerful aegis over the town of Darkshire.
BYou have done a great thing for our people, $N. Your name will remain in our annals forever.

277.name: Fire Taboo
desc: Bring Rethiel the Greenwarden 9 Crude Flints.
objectives: Bring Rethiel the Greenwarden 9 Crude Flints.
details: The Mosshides are cutting the trees of the Wetlands, using the trees' flesh to warm themselves with fire. I will suffer this pain no longer!
BRid the Mosshides of their crude flints, the tools they use to make fire. The flints are borne by all Mosshides except the smaller Mosshide gnolls and Mosshide mongrels.
completion: ... thank you. I will smash these flints and cast them into the sea, so that they may never again be used to burn living wood.

301.name: Report to Ironforge
desc: Take Ironband's Progress Report to Prospector Stormpike.
objectives: Take Ironband's Progress Report to Prospector Stormpike.
details: We'll need approval to get Ironband more blastpowder. You'll have to take his report to the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge.
BHere's the report. Give it to Prospector Stormpike, and don't forget to duck after you deliver it. Stormpike is hotheaded, and he won't be happy to hear of Ironband's slow progress at the site.
BYou'll find Stormpike in the Assembly of Explorers.
completion: Curse that Ironband! I sent him a load of blastpowder weeks ago, but he's made no mention of it in this report.
BSo...where did the blastpowder go?!?

325.name: Armed and Ready
desc: Bring Morbent's Bane to Sven in Duskwood.
objectives: Bring Morbent's Bane to Sven in Duskwood.
details: Here is the weapon against the fiend of which you spoke. You're all ready, $N. Best of luck to you, and I look forward to your tale of glory!
completion: Ah, this will be proof against the fiend Morbent Fel! Well done!
BYou are ready. Morbent Fel will fall.

373.name: The Unsent Letter
desc: Deliver the Letter to the City Architect to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
objectives: Deliver the Letter to the City Architect to Baros Alexston in Stormwind.
details: Searching Edwin VanCleef's person, you discover, among other things, an unsent letter. It is addressed to Baros Alexston, the City Architect of Stormwind, City Hall, Cathedral Square.
BIt appears to be recently written and sealed.
completion: Edwin VanCleef, you say? I would as much expect a letter from my dead grandmother... So you've killed him then? Pardon me in saying, but I'm somewhat surprised. He was a peerless fighter in his younger years. Let's see what he finds the need to write to me about after so many years.
B<Baros peruses the letter.>
BEdwin... I see the years haven't changed you a bit, an idealist as ever, and a romantic. He doesn't care who he hurts, $N. Revenge has consumed him. But then, I'm not sure I can blame him.

397.name: You Have Served Us Well
desc: Speak with Zggi, the servant of Zardeth the Blackclaw, to claim your reward.
objectives: Speak with Zggi, the servant of Zardeth the Blackclaw, to claim your reward.
details: I hear Lord Wishock enjoyed his beverage.

BYou have served us well, $N. The Warlocks of Stormwind will be able to practice our ways without disturbance, thanks to you. For your efforts, I have prepared a special gift for you. Speak with my servant, Zggi, and claim your reward.
completion: Master says give gift to $N. Zggi wants to keep nice gift but Zggi knows better than to betray Master.

421.name: Prove Your Worth
desc: Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher wants you to kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.
objectives: Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher wants you to kill 5 Moonrage Whitescalps.
details: Lady Sylvanas has charged Varimathras with the conquering of the human and dwarven lands to the south.
BBut that fool, Arugal -- charlatan of Dalaran and now cursed beast of Shadowfang Keep -- let his reckless magic wreak havoc with the strategic stronghold of Silverpine Forest.

BI need someone skilled in the ways of combat to help clean up Arugal's mess. Prove yourself to me by killing 5 Moonrage Whitescalps. The wretched beasts can often be found just off the road, down the hill below.
completion: You have served me well, $C. It is obvious to me that you will be a worthy aide to me as I prepare to rid Silverpine Forest of Arugal's curse.

445.name: Delivery to Silverpine Forest
desc: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.
objectives: Take Apothecary Johaan's findings to Apothecary Renferrel in Silverpine Forest.
details: Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas. Surely you know this by now.

BAs a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.
BTake these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Follow the roads to the south from Brill. From the Undercity go southwest.
completion: Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research. With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and Tirisfal Glades. Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.
BBut you must excuse my rambling. Extend your stay in Silverpine, $N. We could use an able bodied $C like you around here.

469.name: Daily Delivery
desc: Deliver the Bundle of Crocolisk Skins to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.
objectives: Deliver the Bundle of Crocolisk Skins to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil Harbor.
details: Greetings, traveler!
BDon't suppose you might be heading in the direction of Menethil, would you? If you're not, I'd suggest you stop there, it's a good place to purchase goods and even have a pint and relax.
BNow, if it just so happens that you're heading in that direction, I don't suppose you'd mind taking this bundle of crocolisk skins to James Halloran, the tanner?
BI'd do it myself, but my wife's been in quite a mood lately, and I'd like to put off facing her as long as possible.
completion: Hmm, this is from Einar, right? Hasn't delivered his skins to me in person for almost a week now. No doubt it's some differences with the wife!
BMaybe I'll have my wife go speak with Sida sometime...

493.name: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills
desc: Deliver Apothecary Renferrel's findings to Apothecary Lydon in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
objectives: Deliver Apothecary Renferrel's findings to Apothecary Lydon in the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
details: The Royal Apothecary Society is under extreme pressure from the Dark Lady to develop a New Plague. We are working diligently and have made much progress. It is our belief that the success will be achieved much faster if we share information amongst the Society.
BFor that reason I want you to deliver my latest findings to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill, a small town nestled in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The journey will be a long one.
BHead south and stick to the roads. Follow the signs closely!
completion: Ah, most excellent. Apothecary Renferrel has my utmost respect. I am anxious to study his work.

517.name: Elixir of Agony
desc: Bring a keg of Shindigger Stout to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Bring a keg of Shindigger Stout to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.
details: This new elixir is finally ready to be tested. But why let a perfectly good, highly contagious plague go to waste on a mere frog or dog? Let's have us some true fun in the name of Lady Sylvanas.

BHead down to Dun Garok. You know the barracks where those filthy little dwarves skitter about. Steal me a keg of their Shindigger Stout. Once I have that keg, you and I will have quite the party, $N.
completion: Finally! Now we are ready for action!

541.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
desc: Travel to Dun Garok and kill 8 Mountaineers, 4 Riflemen, 2 Priests and Captain Ironhill and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Travel to Dun Garok and kill 8 Mountaineers, 4 Riflemen, 2 Priests and Captain Ironhill and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
details: Dwarves aiding the humans? Damn those filthy little beasts.

BWe shall test the strength of the so-called Alliance. We'll see how anxious those little ankle-bashers are to help the humans once they feel our wrath. We know exactly where their stronghold is in this territory.

BThey have established a barracks in southeastern Hillsbrad along Thoradin's Wall called Dun Garok. The final mission of this battle is to lay siege on Dun Garok, $c. Captain Ironhill, their leader, must die.
completion: Your actions on the battlefield are worthy of the highest praise.

565.name: Bartolo's Yeti Fur Cloak
desc: Bring Bartolo Ginsetti of Southshore a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak, Fine Thread and 10 clumps of Yeti Fur.
objectives: Bring Bartolo Ginsetti of Southshore a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak, Fine Thread and 10 clumps of Yeti Fur.
details: I, the great Bartolo, shall make for you the world famous, Alliance renowned, Yeti Fur Cloak!
BTravel the planet and find yourself a better cloak, I dare you. Oh wait, what is that, little $r? "Bartolo, there is no finer cloak!" Yes, yes! That, I have heard before.
BBartolo requires a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak made by a skilled leatherworker, Fine Thread and Yeti Fur, of course! Bring to me these items and you shall be a happy customer!
completion: Now it is time for the great Bartolo to work his magic! I require no wizard's staff, no mage's rod. For I, the great Bartolo, work magic with a mere needle and thread!

589.name: The Singing Crystals
desc: Bring 3 Pulsing Blue Shards to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
objectives: Bring 3 Pulsing Blue Shards to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
details: Legends tell of a jewel, hidden deep in the heart of Stranglethorn. We call it the Mind's Eye, and it has great powers. If you gain this Eye then, perhaps, we can use it to bring lost Yenniku back from the darkness.

BI will consult with the spirits of the jungle to find the Mind's Eye. While I do this, you enter the Crystalvein Mine, southeast of here, and gather Pulsing Blue Shards from Ironjaw Basilisks. The shards are rare, but we will need their magic to bend the Mind's Eye to our will.
completion: You have done well, $N. These shards are well formed. Already I hear them sing to me.
BAnd while you were gone, I spoke with the spirits of the jungle. I know where the Mind's Eye rests...
B...And who guards it.

613.name: Cracking Maury's Foot
desc: Bring Maury's Key to "Sea Wolf" Mackinley in Booty Bay.
objectives: Bring Maury's Key to "Sea Wolf" Mackinley in Booty Bay.
details: Curses! That swab Maury put a lock on his foot, and I can't open it! His loot's inside the foot, and that's what he owes me!

BWe need to find the key to open the lock. Maury was known to gamble with the Mosh'Ogg ogres, at their mound to the northeast. And he told me, when he was still alive, that the last time he went to the mound he was chased off after winning too much. Maybe the Ogres there have his key.
BBut if they do, you might have to kill a load of them to find the right one...
completion: You found it! Thanks a million, $N. You've been a big help to me!
BHere you go - you earned this!

637.name: Sully Balloo's Letter
desc: Deliver Sully Balloo's Letter to Sara Balloo.
objectives: Deliver Sully Balloo's Letter to Sara Balloo.
details: The waterlogged and war-torn envelope dissolves in your hands, leaving you with a few pages of a letter in your grasp, written with painstaking care.
BThe letter is addressed to a Mrs. Sara Balloo of Ironforge and begins, "My dear Sara...."
completion: You say you saw my Sully pinned beneath the icy waters? Say it isn't so!
BLet me read what he wrote....

661.name: Hints of a New Plague?
desc: Find Phin Odelic in Southshore.
objectives: Find Phin Odelic in Southshore.
details: I've seen Kinelory look way worse after a night in the tavern than she does now. You obviously did a good job protecting her.

BThese items she brought back from the farm should at least let Phin get an idea of what's going on out here in Arathi. Just to make sure there's no retaliation after your attack, we're going to stay here for a bit longer. Would you be willing to head back to Southshore and talk to Phin?
completion: So, the two troublemakers are all right after all? Haha, I'm glad to hear it. I thank you for bringing me news of their whereabouts and status--it pleases me greatly that they are still alive; the two of them are irreplaceable as friends and traveling companions.
BBut... it's more important I thank you properly for your help. Here. Take this along with my group's thanks.
BWith any luck, we'll figure out what the Forsaken are up to, and put an end to it.

685.name: Wanted!  Otto and Falconcrest
desc: Bring Otto's Head and Falconcrest's Head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
objectives: Bring Otto's Head and Falconcrest's Head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
details: The Stromgarde Militia has placed bounties on the heads of Lord Falconcrest, and his bodyguard Otto. Falconcrest heads the Syndicate's efforts in the Arathi Highlands, and his death would cause a major disruption in those efforts.
BHis bodyguard Otto, although not a strategic target, is a fierce opponent and has killed dozens of our defenders.
BTheir bounties may be collected from Captain Nials.
completion: Falconcrest and Otto? Wonderful!
BHere is your reward, $N. I am happy to pay it.

709.name: Solution to Doom
desc: Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.
objectives: Bring the Tablet of Ryun'eh to Theldurin the Lost.
details: Oh my! Oh my! There is a doom approaching. Mark me! A doom!
BNo, I cannot speak of it...cannot utter their names or they may hear me! But if we learn, yes, if we learn more of them...then maybe we can learn how to foil them!
BMaybe.
BGo into Uldaman. No! I said it! You must find...find the tablet of...Ryun'eh. Yes, find it! And don't make me speak that name again!
BIt is deep in that place, in an ancient chest. That's where it hides...in a chest crafted before the works of any dwarf.
completion: Oh, fortune is with us! Thank you! We may yet be saved!

733.name: Scrounging
desc: Get 7 pieces of Scrap Metal for Sigrun.
objectives: Get 7 pieces of Scrap Metal for Sigrun.
details: It's going to be tough going here if I can't manage to scrounge up some materials to construct some defenses and other necessities. I've noticed that the ogres in the area seem to be well equipped with scrap metal. Maybe the stories of siege engines in the Badlands weren't so far off after all...
BAnyways, the Prospector's been getting worried about the state of our little camp, so I'd like to get working soon if I can.
BThe main ogre camp is at Dustbelch Grotto, a good trek to the west of here.
completion: It's a start, $N, and it'll have to do until we hear word from Ironforge or the Explorers' League.
BNow, if only I could find some salt somewhere for my quenching barrel...

757.name: Rite of Strength
desc: Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
objectives: Kill Bristlebacks in Brambleblade Ravine and bring 12 Bristleback Belts to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
details: The Rites of the Earthmother are the steps a young tauren needs to take to gain respect in Thunder Bluff.
BFirst you must pass the Rite of Strength. In this test you must prove your bravery by slaying enemies of the tribe.
BBristlebacks of Brambleblade Ravine to the east are encroaching on our tribal lands. They ambush our hunting parties and steal from the village by dark.
BShow your valor by slaying these villains and return to the Chief in Camp Narache with their belts as proof of your deeds.
completion: You have passed the first test of the Rites of the Earthmother. The tribe will be proud.

781.name: Attack on Camp Narache
desc: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
objectives: Bring the Bristleback Attack Plans to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache.
details: After carefully evaluating the map, you realize that what you discovered are the plans made by the Bristleback warchief for an extended siege on Camp Narache.
BSurely Chief Hawkwind could use this information!
completion: This is quite alarming indeed! But with this information we can call on our brethren from Bloodhoof Village to help thwart the attack. You have saved the lives of many tauren, $N.

805.name: Report to Sen'jin Village
desc: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
objectives: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.
details: Your trials against the Burning Blade are finished... here in the Valley. But I want you to report your findings.
BGo to the troll village of Sen'jin and seek out Master Gadrin. Sen'jin Village is east out of the valley, then right at the fork.
BTell Gadrin of the Burning Blade, and that they have reached the Valley of Trials. Discover from him if they have yet reached Sen'jin.
BGo, $N, and be swift. I fear the evil found in the Burning Blade Coven is but the herald of a larger threat...
completion: Hm... your report comes at a bad time. The Burning Blade is not seen here in Sen'jin, but their evil has taken seed off the coast, on the Echo Isles.
BThe orcs are friends of the Darkspear Trolls. Honorable friends. We want to help the orcs, but... we need help too.$B

829.name: Neeru Fireblade
desc: Bring an Example Collar to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring an Example Collar to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.
details: The Searing Collars you brought me are powerful, demonic implements. Divining their origin is, I'm afraid, beyond my skills as a shaman. We will need a warlock to study them.

BTake a searing collar to Neeru Fireblade. Although he is a skilled warlock, he professes to use his powers to thwart demons, and claims his research in the occult is benign. Be that true or false, we may need his aid against the demonic cult in Durotar.
BYou may find Neeru in Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow.
completion: Ah, and where did you get this? Good Margoz in Razor Hill sent you to me, did he?
BWell, let me take a closer look...

853.name: Apothecary Zamah
desc: Bring the Rendered Spores to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, before the time limit is up.
objectives: Bring the Rendered Spores to Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff, before the time limit is up.
details: I have rendered the spores you gave me into an emulsion. I must now send it to my associate, Apothecary Zamah. If you were to carry this to her, she can offer you something from our stores of alchemical goods.
BShe is in the Pools of Vision, a cave beneath the shamans of Thunder Bluff. The path to this cave is well hidden, but you may find it on the Spirit Rise bluff.
BDo hurry. This emulsion will maintain its potency for only a short time, and must be resealed and processed before then.
completion: Ah, the spores from the Barrens that Helbrim was gathering. He garnered your aid in delivering them? Good.
BAnd the emulsion is still potent, so you must have wasted no time in the delivery. Well done, $C.

877.name: The Stagnant Oasis
desc: Return to Tonga at The Crossroads, after investigating the Stagnant Oasis.
objectives: Return to Tonga at The Crossroads, after investigating the Stagnant Oasis.
details: Like the one you found at the Forgotten Pools, there may be fissures at the other oases in the Barrens. If so, then perhaps the fissures are the oases' source of life.
BWe must test this.
BHere, take these seeds. They are dead and infertile, but take them to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast. If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it...and observe.
completion: Your findings are amazing! The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead. Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!
BWe must study this more...

901.name: Samophlange
desc: Get the Console Key from Tinkerer Sniggles to use on the control console.
objectives: Get the Console Key from Tinkerer Sniggles to use on the control console.
details: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.
completion: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.

925.name: Cairne's Hoofprint
desc: Travel to Thunder Bluff to see about getting Cairne Bloodhoof's hoofprint for your ward.
objectives: Travel to Thunder Bluff to see about getting Cairne Bloodhoof's hoofprint for your ward.
details: They say that Cairne Bloodhoof is one of the greatest heroes the Horde has ever seen. When I grow up, I wanna be a hero of the Horde too!

BDo you know Cairne, $N? Could you do me a favor, please? Could you get his hoofprint for me? I dunno how to ask him, and he'd probably be too busy for someone like me... but you! You're an adventurer just like he is! I bet he'd give you his hoofprint easy!
BPlease?
completion: WOW! You got Cairne's hoofprint for me! Thank you very much! And wow... he wrote a personal message on here - to me! I knew he'd be totally cool, I just did! Maybe someday I'll thank him myself... when I become a hero of the Horde!
BYou're the best, $N. Thank you for being so nice to me.

949.name: The Twilight Camp
desc: Find a clue in the Twilight's Hammer camp at the Master's Glaive.
objectives: Find a clue in the Twilight's Hammer camp at the Master's Glaive.
details: The Twilight's Hammer's purpose at the Master's Glaive is not known. But it must be dark.
BSearch through their camp at the Glaive... Search for some thing that may teach us their intentions.
BFor we must learn their intentions before a plan is made.
completion: This book is hand printed in an ancient language, and illustrated by a master artist.

973.name: The Tower of Althalaxx
desc: Bring Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
objectives: Bring Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.
details: Ilkrud Magthrull. Yes, I have knowledge of him. He is a powerful orc warlock that makes his residence at the Fire Scar Shrine, a place of great evil in southwestern Ashenvale.
BHe had been little more than an annoyance until now, and I had not dealt with him, but it seems that his time has come.
completion: It was a grand thing you did today, $n. You should be quite proud of yourself for having faced down a warlock of such power.
BNow, let's see what we can learn from Ilkrud's writings.

997.name: Denalan's Earth
desc: Bring the package of Rare Earth to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
objectives: Bring the package of Rare Earth to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
details: Are you heading to the south? To Lake Al'Ameth? If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

BMy colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil. He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.
BCan you take the package to him?
completion: Ah, it's here! I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time. I hope it's still fresh...
BThank you for bringing it to me, $N. You are a $R who is generous with his time.

1021.name: Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!
desc: Find Anilia in Xavian.
objectives: Find Anilia in Xavian.
details: Listen, I don't know who you are, but I need your help. My sisters went to take back the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr. They said they'd be back soon, but it's been two whole days!
B$n, you have to find them! They were looking for the ruins of a night elf temple in Xavian to the northwest. I don't know what to think. Look for Anilia, she was leading them on the search.
completion: Judging by the gaping wound in her side, Anilia is on the verge of death.

1045.name: Raene's Cleansing
desc: Kill Ran Bloodtooth and 4 Bloodtooth Guards and return to Krolg near Lake Mystral.
objectives: Kill Ran Bloodtooth and 4 Bloodtooth Guards and return to Krolg near Lake Mystral.
details: The night elves are as old as time, but their arrogance destroys their very world. And now it destroys our lives too. But that can no longer be controlled...
BI blame the elves for much, but we are still responsible for our actions. Even beyond the corruption, we are capable of great evil.

BRan Bloodtooth is one such evil. Power hungry, lusting... the corruption has only made him stronger. My hatred for the elves burns, but I do not wish ill upon their children, so we must police our own.
completion: You have done well, my friend.
BThe forest is still tainted, but at least we know we have done a small part to return it to its former glory. If you wish to return to me again, I would enjoy the company of my own kind.
BBe well. Perhaps our tribes will meet again under less violent times.

1069.name: Deepmoss Spider Eggs
desc: Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
objectives: Bring 15 Deepmoss Eggs to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
details: Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay! The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.
BI smell an opportunity!
BIn Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider. Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!
BIn Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.
BIn Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
completion: You got them! Thank you!
BI'll have these sent to Dizzywig and get them shipped to Booty Bay. I can already taste the profits!
BHere is your cut, $N. I couldn't have made this deal without you.

1093.name: Super Reaper 6000
desc: Get the Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints for Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
objectives: Get the Super Reaper 6000 Blueprints for Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains.
details: Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome!
BLucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out!

BTells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
completion: Hey, is that what I think it is? Great!

BNow, let's see. Ugh... how am I supposed to understand this stuff... can't figure out the way gnomes think. Lemme tell you, I'm surprised they could build the wheel, let alone those flying machines they like so much.

1117.name: Rumors for Kravel
desc: Bring the Goblin Rumors to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Bring the Goblin Rumors to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
details: I had to use some of my favors, and gave away a rare bottle of elven wine, and did some heavy deducing myself! But I found the information you seek.
BHere, I wrote a letter with some very interesting bits on our friend, Nazz Steamboil. Do with it what you will -- it's too dangerous for me to use.
BJust don't tell anyone where you got it!
completion: Well well! This is interesting... very interesting. Heh, perhaps I should bow to the goblin pilot the next time I see him.
BThis is worth plenty, $N. I'm sure Nazz will pay a small fortune to keep his secret... a secret.

1141.name: The Family and the Fishing Pole
desc: Catch 6 Darkshore Grouper for Gubber Blump in Auberdine.
objectives: Catch 6 Darkshore Grouper for Gubber Blump in Auberdine.
details: I love fishing. The Blump family is known for fishing. My name is Gubber Blump; I fish.

BThere's a kind of fish I like to catch around these parts called Darkshore grouper. I used to go out on a boat to fish for grouper, but no boats have been going out since them mean ol' murlocs moved in. I bet they been eating up all the grouper too.
BSay, you wanna help me catch Darkshore grouper? I'd give you a bona fide Blump Family Fishing Pole if you did! It's a real good pole to catch fish with.
completion: Them's some real nice groupers, $N! Thanks for helping me out!

BYou're at least as good of a fisherman as my cousin, Graun Blump. She also has a beard and she smells kinda funny, but that don't do nothing to stop her fishing. I reckon you have what it takes to use a Blump Family Fishing Pole.

1189.name: Safety First
desc: Return the Modified Seaforium Booster to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Return the Modified Seaforium Booster to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.
details: There, I did what Razzeric wanted. Just tell him to be careful when he sets this off. If he makes the slightest mistake, he won't be moving forward, he'll just be a burnt spot on the track.
BWould be a shame, too, if that happened. Who knows if our nineteenth driver would be any good?
completion: Now that's more like it! I wish I could see the look on the gnomes' eyes when they see me set this baby off.
BToo bad I'll be too busy pulling off a new course record!

1261.name: Marg Speaks
desc: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Nazeer in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Nazeer in Brackenwall Village.
details: Cursed muckshell! You can't kill Marg! Ah, but I am dead. So it must have slain me...
BBut my mission! My mission! You, $N, must complete it.
BWhile near Theramore, I spied a group of Alliance soldiers camped on the beach. And one soldier wore a pendant... a pendant laden with more gems than any soldier could afford!
BThat night I snuck into their camp and stole the pendant, but on my return to base a muckshell crab-man killed me!
B$N, you must find that muckshell and recover the pendant!
completion: This pendant was worn by a soldier of Stormwind??
BThank you, $N. You have revealed the secret of Marg's death. But this pendant is a new mystery to solve, one that may have dire effects on the Alliance, and the Horde.

1285.name: Daelin's Men
desc: Return the information about Reethe to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
objectives: Return the information about Reethe to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
details: Reddon... Redpath... Ah, here it is! Lieutenant Paval Reethe.

BJoined the Theramore guard along with most of the recruits that came across the sea with Lady Proudmoore. Enlisted with the marines of Kul Tiras at the age of sixteen. Distinguished service, promotions...
BListed as missing.
completion: Missing? That would be Tesoran's kind way of saying traitor.
BNo doubt he's one of those fools so blindly loyal to Admiral Daelin that he turned traitor. Isn't that a delicious irony? The deserters accuse us of betraying the Alliance.

1381.name: Khan Hratha
desc: Maintain your Magram reputation, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
objectives: Maintain your Magram reputation, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
details: The Gelkis Khan is dead, and now the Maraudine will fall! Kill the Maraudine Khan, Hratha!

BTo face him, blow the horn on the high bluff in the Valley of Spears. But to blow the horn, you need a mouthpiece. To get a mouthpiece, kill Maraudine centaur. Keep killing until you find a mouthpiece. Then blow the horn.
BDo this and Maraudine centaur will come to the tower. Kill them until Khan Hratha appears. Hratha holds the piece of a key. Give this piece to me...
completion: Khan Hratha is dead! Now the Magram are the strongest of the centaur! We will crush the others, and rule Desolace!
BWe will remember, you, $N, and you will be spared our hooves when all others are trampled.

1429.name: The Atal'ai Exile
desc: Bring the Bundle of Atal'ai Artifacts to the Atal'ai Exile in the Hinterlands.
objectives: Bring the Bundle of Atal'ai Artifacts to the Atal'ai Exile in the Hinterlands.
details: While you were braving the dangers of the Pool of Tears, one of my scouts returned with a scroll written in blood on dried flesh. It seems to be a judicial sentence against a priest of the Atal'ai tribe.
BThis priest was sentenced to a fate worse than death amongst the Atal'ai.
BHe was exiled to live far north in the Hinterlands, with the Witherbark trolls.
BI will bundle these artifacts. You are to seek out the exile and discover their true use. Return to me once your journey is complete.
completion: You bring me the summoning artifacts of the Atail'ai?
BI see Jammal'an the Prophet is leading the disciples of the Chamber of Blood towards their chosen fate. Has Hakkar returned to the Temple I wonder? Has their fate been met?

1453.name: Reclaimers' Business in Desolace
desc: Speak to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
objectives: Speak to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
details: There's work to be done in Desolace, $N. It's an atrocious place, befouled by centaur and other nasties. But if you're looking for a good week's honest work, then head there, meet with Kreldig Ungor, and tell him I sentcha.

BYou can find him holed up at Nijel's Point--it's a little cozy camp hidden in the mountains of northern Desolace. Just head east if you enter from the Stonetalon Mountains. It's easy to miss, so be on the lookout.
completion: Glad to see the Reclaimers aren't in short supply of work, or adventurers willing to help out.

BI'm Kreldig, $N. You've made a smart move helpin' out the Reclaimers. Everyone needs something these days: they've lost a family heirloom, a magic item, a loved one. You never can tell. But with the Reclaimers around, there's no reason, for the right price, everyone can't find what they've lost.

1477.name: Vital Supplies
desc: Speak with Watchmaster Sorigal.
objectives: Speak with Watchmaster Sorigal.
details: Our mages are conducting research at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands, research vital to our understanding of the Dark Portals. They require nearly constant supplies, but our supply line to Nethergarde is tenuous.
BYou must help ensure the supplies make it to Nethergard. Report to Watchmaster Sorigal in Darkshire, and do as he asks. This task will take you into hostile lands, $N. Prepare yourself.
completion: Andromath sent you? Very good. I have an important task for you...

1501.name: Creature of the Void
desc: Retrieve the Tablet of Verga for Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Retrieve the Tablet of Verga for Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
details: So few warlocks remain... We risk much, but the risks are warranted. You must quickly reach maturity in your ability if you are to be of use to the Horde and to the Warchief.
BIt is time that you learned a new summoning spell.

BFirst, you must recover the Tablet of Verga, which was stolen by warlocks of the Burning Blade and is now kept at their lair in Skull Rock to the east of the city. With the tablet, I will show you the runes necessary to summoning a voidwalker.
completion: Good. I hope you inflicted some other losses on the Burning Blade when you went to retrieve this.
BThey have been a source of great annoyance for the Warchief, and a great blight upon warlocks as a whole.

1525.name: Call of Fire
desc: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Telf Joolam in Durotar.
objectives: Bring 1 Fire Tar and 1 Reagent Pouch to Telf Joolam in Durotar.
details: But you did not come here for a history lesson, did you? You came for the Eternal Flame and fire totem.
BThe first step is to create a sapta and bind you to the flame.
BI can create the fire sapta for you if you bring me two items. The first is fire tar, a simple item usually carried by Razormane spellcasters in eastern Barrens.
BThe second item will be more dangerous: a reagent pouch from one of the cultists of the Burning Blade. You can find them in a cave above the ravines northeast of Razor Hill.
completion: These will do nicely, $N.

BFire is more than chaos and destruction--do well to remember that. It is also about life, and creation. All things are tied together in such a way. Forces oppose one another, but at the same time, one cannot exist without the other. Both extinguish one another, but also give one another meaning. Always remember this.
BUsing different types of magic in conjunction with one another will show not only true skill, but great wisdom.

1693.name: Weapons of Elunite
completion: $N, I have crafted these weapons with the elunite you brought to me. Please, take whichever most suits you.
BAnd I must thank you. Working with elunite is both an honor and a pleasure.

1717.name: Gakin's Summons
desc: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
objectives: Report to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
details: $n! Didn't expect to see you around these parts, but I was instructed to keep an eye out for you.
BIt's past time you got some more training, so you should stop in to see Gakin the next time you're in Stormwind. He'll be waiting for you.
completion: I'm glad someone was able to get a hold of you, $n. I was beginning to fear the worst. It would be a shame to lose you, after the time we've invested in you. We can talk later, though. Your training is the only important thing now.

1861.name: Mirror Lake
desc: Bring a Mirror Lake sample to Jennea Cannon in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring a Mirror Lake sample to Jennea Cannon in Stormwind.
details: This world has been victim to massive mystic struggles, which tore magic currents from once stable channels. We struggle to determine the effects these changes have caused, and some of us fear the worst!
BBut I will reveal more of this later. Right now, we need you to gather information.

BHere, take this flask. Go to the base of the waterfall at Mirror Lake, southwest of the Stormwind gates, and retrieve a sample of the water there. Return it to me so that I might test it for magical taints.
completion: Thank you, $N. I will test this water for magical properties. Let us hope that it contains none, or we may find that those who drink from Mirror Lake for too long will be adversely affected.
BHere, $N. Take this orb or staff as a token of your service. May it serve you well.

1885.name: Mennet Carkad
desc: Speak with Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
objectives: Speak with Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter of the Undercity.
details: $n? Not quite what I was expecting, considering Carkad himself has taken an interest to you. Looks can be deceiving though, right?
BEither way, you should go see him as soon as possible. You wouldn't want to know what happened to the last few that chose to ignore his summons.
completion: Hm. No doubt you made your way here at first mention of my summons, yes? Of course. I would expect no less from a prospective Deathstalker.

1957.name: Mana Surges
desc: Kill 12 Mana Surges in the allowed time limit.
objectives: Kill 12 Mana Surges in the allowed time limit.
details: We are almost finished, but this last step is the most perilous, $N.

BI have the empty summoner's orb and am ready to empower it. We will do this by harnessing the energy of a mana rift. I'll cast a spell that will temporarily open a rift, from which creatures, mana surges, will pour out. You must defeat the mana surges and their power will be released, which I will then collect.
BKill enough mana surges before the rift closes and I will place all their collected energy in your orb.
completion: You did it! I never doubted you for a second! Ok, maybe for just a second, or two... but basically I didn't have much doubt.
BHonest.

2341.name: Necklace Recovery, Take 3
desc: Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.
objectives: Visit Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath to see if he was successful.
details: As Dran and Malton Droffers begin to squabble over their new salvage, half of the deal is now complete. A trip to the Badlands is now in order to finish things up, as Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath might have a special reward waiting for you there.
completion: The power source you gave me exceeded every expectation I had for it. I was able to make both you and me a necklace, and I have enough left over to make at least three more. They will fetch quite the fee, with Droffers and Son Salvage none the wiser.
BHere you go, my friend. I give you my thanks on a splendid job... and something quite special for your trouble.

2581.name: Snickerfang Jowls
desc: Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.
objectives: Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.
details: It is a well known fact that hyenas possess tremendous strength in their jowls, but the strength to snap through three inches of thorium steel? Impossible, improbable, and yet I have seen this demonstrated with my own eyes.

BVenture forth, into the Blasted Lands, and bring me three snickerfang jowls. As you search for the snickerfang, be on the lookout for boars and scorpoks: The initial assay also requires two blasted boar lungs and one scorpok pincer to complete.
completion: How do you feel, $N? You radiate with the aura of the snickerfang--your strength, unmatched by mortals!
BUnfortunately, with the components you brought to me, I could only make enough of the assay for one tablet. I will require more components, should you require another tablet.

2605.name: The Thirsty Goblin
desc: Collect a Laden Dew Gland and bring it to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Collect a Laden Dew Gland and bring it to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.
details: I've got an idea, see. I've heard of some strange creatures called dew collectors that live to the southwest... and that they are able to store water in special glands.
BI think that if I could get one of these glands, I could create a drink that would quench my terrible thirst! Do you think you could help me, $N?
BLook for the cactus garden, $N; that's where you'll find the dew collectors.
completion: Oh, wonderful! Give it here -- let me drink it!

2701.name: Heroes of Old
desc: Open the chest and claim your reward.
objectives: Open the chest and claim your reward.
details: Please, take from this a relic of old. We no longer have a use for the item.
BMay it serve you well in your fight against the legion.$B
completion: You are temporarily blinded by the sparkle and gleam.

2773.name: The Mithril Kid
desc: Bring two Heavy Mithril Breastplates and one Ornate Mithril Gloves to Trenton Lighthammer.
objectives: Bring two Heavy Mithril Breastplates and one Ornate Mithril Gloves to Trenton Lighthammer.
details: Around these parts I am known as the Mithril Kid. I supply ornate mithril to adventurers from around the world.
B<Trenton whispers.>
BLittle do they know that I do not know the technique to fashion ornate mithril gloves. Shhhh! This will be our little secret.
BTeach me the technique to create ornate mithril gloves, $N, and in exchange, I will show you the resultant of the culmination of my training under Galvan: the ornate mithril breastplate.
completion: Thank you for all that you have taught me, $N. The master and commander of the ornate mithril set will soon be in your possession.
BBehold!

2821.name: The Mark of Quality
desc: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: My philosophy on leatherworking is that the work must be the best quality possible - no compromises. Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter is trying to sell you ocean-front property in Dun Morogh!

BIn my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have run across thick yeti hides. The Yeti are native to Feralas, with many found in Feral Scar Vale. I want some, and I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten. If that sounds fair to you, then we're in business.
completion: Did you stop and examine the texture of these hides? Properly treated, these hides could very well be stronger than iron. Not many people know about these hides, and that in combination with the vast treating solutions I know will allow me to potentially make items with a true mark of quality... thanks to you, of course!
BAnd now, please choose from what I am able to offer you for your service!

2845.name: Wandering Shay
desc: Pick up Shay's Bell from the chest.
Escort Shay Leafrunner to Rockbiter's camp.
objectives: Pick up Shay's Bell from the chest.
BEscort Shay Leafrunner to Rockbiter's camp.
details: Do you think you could help me find my way back to my friend, Rockbiter? He was supposed to be watching me... But I do have a tendency to wander off now and then. There are just so many things to see, and I get so distracted.
BThere is one thing that will always work to get my attention, though.
BInside this chest, you'll find a bell that is very precious to me. I just love the sound of it. You have my word, if I wander off, all you have to do is ring it and I'll come running back.
completion: What? You say dis bell will work when Shay runs off? Well, how 'bout that!
BSince you did so much fer me, here ya go, $N.

2869.name: Against the Hatecrest
desc: Bring 10 Hatecrest Naga Scales to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Bring 10 Hatecrest Naga Scales to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: The best course of action at this point is to assume that, regardless of what the naga are up to, they will eventually move to secure the island for their own. We need to take aggressive steps to counter that threat before it is too late.

BBring me ten Hatecrest Scales that are in good condition; it should be obvious to you how to acquire them. You'll cut your teeth on the naga for the first time, and we'll have a weakened naga presence on Sardor Isle - both are prospects that play to our advantage.
completion: Yes, yes, these scales are more than satisfactory. Actually, I think I will send these down to Pratt for him to take a look at. Maybe he can craft something useful out of them.

BAs for you, I have another mission I want to send you on. But first, here is your bounty for the scales. Your continued service to the General and Feathermoon Stronghold at large is a blessing in the face of adversity.

2941.name: The Borrower
desc: Take the letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris.
objectives: Take the letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris.
details: I have studied many subjects in my time, and my latest fascination is with the snapjaw that occupy the beach in the Hinterlands. There's one in particular I'd like to see, a giant snapjaw named Gammerita. I'd like to go myself, but my research keeps me here. I think a picture of her would be the next best thing.
BTake this letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris. She has created an invention for me that can capture a picture. She called it a "snapshot", I think...
completion: Are you another one of Daryn's interns? She's quite a knowledgeable historian, $N. You should be grateful to be studying under her leadership.
BNow, let me get the Super Snapper FX. You're gonna love it!

2965.name: Portents of Uldum
desc: Speak with Nara Wildmane on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Nara Wildmane on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
details: Ah, $n, it is fortuitous that you have come to me again. Your revelations at the Uldaman dig site have certainly given us sages much discuss. I was doing just that with one of the druids, Nara Wildmane, when it dawned on me that her past adventuring experiences may have some great importance as to the next step we need to take.
BI would like for you to speak with her concerning her travels to the Valley of the Watchers in the Tanaris desert. She waits for you on the Elder Rise.
completion: There is a place deep in the Tanaris desert called the Valley of the Watchers. The discs that you recovered... their translated glyphs make mention of a place called Uldum. Most think this place to be a myth.
BI know this to be false; Uldum exists. I've been there. Well... outside, at any rate.
BThe crux is this, $N: we think there is a connection between the discs and Uldum, and we want you to go there.

2989.name: The Altar of Zul
desc: Check the top of the Altar of Zul, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
objectives: Check the top of the Altar of Zul, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
details: Sharpbeak was not with the Witherbark trolls. Perhaps the Vilebranch trolls took him. Go to the Altar of Zul on the western edge of Vilebranch territory and search for the gryphon child.
completion: Sharpbeak wasn't there? That is bad news, but it is good news too...
BIt is good that he was not at the Altar of Zul for the Vilebranch trolls are known for performing sacrifices.
BI thank you for all of your aid, but I'm afraid I have an even greater task ahead.

3085.name: Hallowed Tablet
desc: Read the Hallowed Tablet and speak to Ken'jai outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
objectives: Read the Hallowed Tablet and speak to Ken'jai outside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
details: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.
BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the priest trainer Ken'jai. He would have words with you when you're ready.
completion: As ya test yeself, ya'll find ya have better an' better control o'er da spirits--ya'll be callin' on dem fer greata an' greata tings... dat's where ol' Ken'jai come in. You come talk to ole Ken'jai when ya feel yer ready. If da spirits agree, den we see 'bout teachin' ya more powerful abilities... but only if da spirits agree.
BGo now, talk to da rest of da Valley's people. Speak to me again later.

3109.name: Encrypted Rune
desc: Read the Encrypted Rune and speak to Solm Hargrin in Coldridge Valley.
objectives: Read the Encrypted Rune and speak to Solm Hargrin in Coldridge Valley.
details: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the rogue trainer Solm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
completion: Anyway, as you start peekin' around Coldridge you'll probably have need of training at some point. You just come back to me whenever you feel you need it and I'll teach you what I know--a trick here, a maneuver there. You know, the stuff that keeps you alive and makin' a little extra coin.
BKeep an eye out on our gnomish friends too... they kinda got the short end of the stick what with Gnomeregan being... destroyed. They'll need our help to feel welcome.

3181.name: The Horn of the Beast
desc: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Mountaineer Pebblebitty.
objectives: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Mountaineer Pebblebitty.$B
details: The gigantic horn has numerous scratches and cracks. An unusual metal object is lodged into the rough surface.
BUpon further examination, you notice that the metal is actually a broken axe head. On the metal, the following words are etched:
BProperty of Mountaineer Pebblebitty.
BWhen you try and dislodge the broken axe head, it shatters into a million pieces.
BWoops!
completion: What have you got there? A fake obviously!

BI've been face to face with Margol and I know for a fact that her horn is at least eight times larger than the one you've got in your hands, $N. You probably got that off of a stormsnout in the Barrens. No ma'am, you can't fool Pebblebitty!

3301.name: Mura Runetotem
desc: Speak with Mura Runetotem in the Sepulcher.
objectives: Speak with Mura Runetotem in the Sepulcher.
details: My clanmate, Mura Runetotem, traveled to Silverpine so that she might aid our undead allies. Silverpine is an ailing forest, a dying forest, and it was Mura's hope to bring it new life. Perhaps the strange life found here in the Barrens can help her work in Silverpine.

BTake a sample of the shells you gathered, and bring it to Mura in Silverpine. She is staying at the Sepulcher. With luck, studying the shell will give her the insight she needs to heal that dying place.
completion: Ah, what is this? This shell has an inner glow, as if it still pulses with life. Amazing! I must study it further.
BThank you, $N. With luck, this shell will hold a secret I can use to aid the poor land of Silverpine.

3373.name: The Essence of Eranikus
desc: Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.
objectives: Place the Essence of Eranikus in the Essence Font located in this lair in the Sunken Temple.
details: As you touch the gem, a deep voice resonates in your mind.

B"Mortal, heed this plea. I am Eranikus of the Green Dragonflight, keeper of this accursed temple. My charge to ensure that the trolls never again bring forth their abomination of a god has for now ended in failure. As I imbue this gem with part of my essence, I sense my grip on the Dream twisting into chaos. Please - place this gem into the essence font in my lair, and let our magic there purge the taint from my psyche so that I may rest."
completion: You place the gem inside the essence font.

B"Thank you mortal, you have - no... this, this cannot be! No! The corruption of this accursed god even taints the sanctity of a Green Dragonflight essence font! No please, I feel my essence ripping from me! THE PAIN! I feel the grip of an eternal nightmare taking hold on me..."
B"Mortal, I implore you! Find one of the Green Dragonflight to stop this... help me... I am chained in darkness... forever in agony... please do not torture..."

3445.name: The Sunken Temple
desc: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.
objectives: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.
details: I have heard of a place that lies deep below the surface of the earth -- banished there by powers greater than I have ever seen.

BIf you wish to learn more of this place; the Sunken Temple, seek out a goblin named Marvon Rivetseeker. Much like Troyas and I, he has studied many ancient areas of the world. He was last known to have left his home in Ratchet to study the troll ruins in Tanaris.
BGood luck finding him; he hasn't been heard from in some time.
completion: Yes, the Sunken Temple, I can say that I have seen it with my own eyes. Perhaps you'd like to hear more about it?
BYou look like the adventurous type -- I know things that may intrigue you...

3517.name: Stealing Knowledge
desc: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.
objectives: Find the Tablet of Beth'Amara, the Tablet of Jin'yael, the Tablet of Markri, and the Tablet of Sael'hai before returning to Jediga in Azshara.
details: I admit, $N, I've made the most of my situation in Azshara. Belgrom's punishment has had its share of benefits.
BBefore I left, I did some research and you would be surprised how many valuable items are lying around.
BI'll tell you more about my deals, and even give you a cut of the profits, if you help me gather some of them.
BThere are tablets throughout the Ruins of Eldarath to the east that I need. All four are named after Highborne wizards. Get them for me and we'll talk some more.
completion: Perfect, $N, and in good condition also. These should get us a good price from all the parties concerned.
BLet's not dawdle around here any longer than we have to. We have some money to make.

3541.name: Delivery to Jes'rimon
desc: Bring the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring the Tablet of Jin'yael to Jes'rimon in Orgrimmar.
details: I have a fence in Orgrimmar. He resides in The Drag. He's difficult to nail down if you don't know where to look, but if you go looking in one of the highest buildings there you should have no problem finding him.
BDo me a favor though, don't go shouting to all of Kalimdor that he's there and what his business is--it'd be bad for both of us.
BHe'll give us more than a fair price for the Tablet of Jin'yael. I'm not sure why, but you should have seen how excited he was to hear about its whereabouts.
completion: Ahhh, Jediga be sendin' her package all the way from Azshara. Good. I be waitin' on this.
BJediga, now that be a fine woman... deadly too. What could be better?
BLook at this... the tablet be in perfect condition. You make a good messenger, $N.

3565.name: Xylem's Payment to Jediga
desc: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
objectives: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.
details: What is it? Oh yes, your payment. Of course.
BTake this and be off with you. I'm sure Jediga is awaiting oh so patiently for your return.
completion: No problems? None at all? Well, that's something to be said... I expected him to show some sort of reluctance or to at least betray our deal. Hmm, maybe he can be trusted after all.
BWell, no need to dwell on it that much. Here's your share. Thank you for your help.

3637.name: Gnome Engineering
desc: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
objectives: If you wish to learn more about Gnome Engineering, take the Manual of Engineering Disciplines to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
details: Engineering at the expert level breaks into two disciplines: gnome and goblin. While I think it is a waste, you should be aware of gnome specialization. They make items and gadgets that claim to change the world, but rarely work.

B$N, read this manual. If you wish to learn how to make metal paper weights, then take the manual to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay. Remember - membership is permanent and prevents joining the other discipline, so make sure you are sure before finishing his task.
completion: You've come to learn about gnome engineering, eh? Well, you've come to the right gnome. While the ruling faction of Gnomeregan may use politics to ostracize those they view as an intellectual threat, they know that knowledge is something they cannot control.
BThey and I both know that when I left Gnomeregan, they lost one of their greatest gnome engineers alive today. If you're a capable student, I'll teach you what I know.

3661.name: Favored of Elune?
desc: Collect 15 Wildkin Feathers from the Hinterlands for Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
objectives: Collect 15 Wildkin Feathers from the Hinterlands for Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
details: Wildkin are quite unpredictable creatures, $N. Capable of incredible gentleness, these creatures will show extreme ferocity if something they deem important is threatened.
BThese beasts are rumored to have been created by Elune, and I am interested in finding if this is really the truth.

BRecently, I heard about a population of wildkin living in the Hinterlands -- Vicious, Primitive, and Savage Owlbeasts. They can be found amongst the wildlife there. Will you gather some wildkin feathers for me?
completion: Thank you for bringing these to me, $N.
BWhat did you learn of the Wildkin?
BPerhaps these feathers will tell us more. Ferocious monsters, or simply misguided pets? One day I'd like to know the truth...
BI am going to continue my research -- please come back and talk to me again after some time has passed.

3781.name: Morrowgrain Research
desc: Take the Arch Druid's Seed Voucher to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.
objectives: Take the Arch Druid's Seed Voucher to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.
details: With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from Un'Goro Crater. These seeds blossom into an array of random, potent herbs. One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I intend to unravel this mystery.
BTake this to Mathrengyl downstairs, and he will give you some seeds so you can get started. If you run out, you will need to purchase more from him.
completion: Yes, this voucher is good for twenty packets of seeds. If you run out, we have more that can be provided. Unfortunately though, Tharlendris seeds are quite costly to produce in significant numbers. This is why the Cenarion Circle asks that those who are assisting us help out by offsetting some of the cost.
BThose who return with morrowgrain find that the reward the Arch Druid offers far makes up for the cost.

3901.name: Rattling the Rattlecages
desc: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.
objectives: Kill 12 Rattlecage Skeletons, and then return to Shadow Priest Sarvis in Deathknell when you are done.
details: You've shown your potential to the Forsaken under normal circumstances $N - now let's see you under pressure.

BThe Rattlecage skeletons, more mindless minions of the Lich King, are a tougher foe than the zombies you have faced thus far. Again, thin their numbers and prove yourself to the Forsaken. Do not tarry - when you are done, speak to me again.
completion: I am finished with you, $N - you have shown yourself to be worthy of the freedom that you have been given. Many will stand against you for what you have become, but know that no matter what they may try to do against us, we are free and will not be shackled again.
BTake these and be on your way. You have much to accomplish, $C.

4021.name: Counterattack!
desc: Bring a Piece of Krom'zar's Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
objectives: Bring a Piece of Krom'zar's Banner to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
details: The Horde commends your successes against the Kolkar, but the Kolkar themselves are maddened. I have reports that a contingent of Kolkar has traveled to the Barrens from their home in Desolace, to seek vengeance. My latest report was that, even now, they move against these bunkers, from the west!
BFace the Kolkar invaders, and end their threat in the Barrens. Kill them until their leader, Warlord Krom'zar, appears. Defeat him and bring me a piece of his banner as proof.
BWe're counting on you, $N.
completion: You have done it! You have defeated the Kolkar!
BI will be sure Thrall receives word of your actions here, $N.
BStand tall. You do yourself, and the Horde, proud.

4141.name: Muigin and Larion
desc: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.
objectives: Collect 15 Bloodpetals and return to Muigin.
details: See Larion over there? It's HIS fault we're here!
BI told him we were going the wrong way, but would he listen? And would you believe that he's the one that won't speak to me? Well, until he changes his mind, let's have a bit of fun with him.
BHave you noticed the strange plant-like creatures around here? They're nothing but trouble, really, but I think if trained properly, I could get them to obey commands.
BFirst thing though, I'll need some samples to study. Do you think you could collect some?
completion: I hope they didn't give you too much trouble, $N. I try to steer clear of them -- they're wild!
BI tried jumping over one... I was attacked! Plants just shouldn't be acting that way!

4261.name: Ancient Spirit
desc: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.
objectives: Escort Arei to safety, then speak with Kayneth Stillwind in Forest Song, in eastern Ashenvale.
details: Felwood was once a peaceful and serene land... Until the legion took hold. The infernals, destruction, chaos...
BThe skull of Gul'dan ensured that none were spared here. All fell to the corruption.

BEven now, as a spirit, I still find myself trapped, bearing the suffering of this land. Help me find my way home. Please, $N, tell me you will lead an ancient spirit away from here, where I may finally rest.
BOnce I am free, seek out Kayneth Stillwind, a druid that resides in Forest Song, to the east.
completion: Yes, $N. Felwood has been through much hardship. Thank you for what you have done.
BOne day, we may be able to reclaim Felwood from the corruption; every kind deed helps.

4285.name: The Northern Pylon
desc: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Discover the location of the Northern Crystal Pylon in Un'Goro Crater.
details: What could they be for? I can't get the thought out of my head!
BIt's driving me crazy -- that the rumors I have heard about the crystal pylons are all true. Call me gullible, but I'll usually believe anything people tell me.
BAnyway, I have heard that there is one of the crystal pylons fairly close. Somewhere in the north... Please locate it, $N. I just know they exist.
completion: I know the stories are true, $N.

4501.name: Beware of Pterrordax
desc: Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
objectives: Kill 10 Pterrordax and 15 Frenzied Pterrordax, then speak to Spraggle Frock at Marshal's Refuge.
details: Wanted: A skilled fighter to deal with the threat of the Pterrordax that inhabit the Un'Goro Crater. Their numbers are growing, and they are becoming a menace to travelers in the area.
BDecrease the population by slaying 10 pterrordax and 15 frenzied pterrordax.
BSpeak with Spraggle Frock after completing the task for a reward.
completion: I am absolutely terrified of the pterrordax here! Thank you for decreasing their numbers, $N. Now I might feel safe enough to venture out of Marshal's Refuge.

4621.name: Avast Ye, Admiral!
desc: Slay Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay, and then return to Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Veil off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Slay Fleet Master Seahorn and Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay, and then return to Fleet Master Firallon aboard the Crimson Veil off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
details: Listen close, sea dawg... the powers of Booty Bay is what keeps us Bloodsail from sailing wheres we like and taking whats we want as rights o' plunder. Were ye to put a knife to Fleet Master Seahorn, we'd ne'er run afoul of a Booty Bay's vessel. Were ye to put a knife to Baron Revilgaz, we'd ne'er face the law on their terms.
BIf ye are to be an honorary admiral amongst us - yes, ADMIRAL, you'll puts a knife to both of 'em as I've says. Go now $g lad : lass;, and return to me once ye does the deeds.
completion: Avast ye... Admiral $N! Yer a pirate of pirates, lass!
BIt warms the cackles of me heart to give ye this hat. Ye will ne'er find one like it anywheres, and all that gazes upon ye will see that yer an Admiral of the Bloodsail Navy!

4741.name: Wild Guardians
desc: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.
objectives: Trull Failbane in Felwood wants you to hunt 13 Moontouched Owlbeasts.
details: In the northern areas of Winterspring, the Wildkin grow even more ferocious. We must continue our measures there.
BHunt the moontouched owlbeasts in Winterspring, and explore the area they inhabit.
BThis is dangerous ground, but I know that you will be able to handle the challenge. Return to me after you have slain 13 of the wildkin.
completion: I sense that you are enjoying your work. And I believe that we are onto something here.

4765.name: Delivery to Ridgewell
desc: Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.
details: I have packaged Doomriggers Clasp into a crate, suitable for shipment to Stormwind. $N, you have been extremely helpful -- can I ask you for one last favor?
BDeliver the crate to Count Remington Ridgewell. You will find him in the Keep of Stormwind. I am sure he'll be very pleased to see what you have for him.
completion: Ah, so you are he! You have my thanks, $N. And... if you didn't already know... the gratitude of a noble in the house of Ridgewell is nigh worth a king's ransom.

4813.name: The Fragments Within
desc: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
objectives: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
details: The moonwell water has revealed that embedded inside the crystal are a few small fragments of bone, as well as half of a jawbone. The jawbone appears to be from a humanoid, but it is unclear without breaking open the crystal - a feat that even the strongest of magic would find near impossible.
BWith the task at hand complete, all that remains is to report back to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
completion: Well, it would seem that even though we know more about this crystal, more unanswered questions are the result!

BI'll take the information you've uncovered to the council here in Auberdine. Perhaps they'll know a course of action to follow on this crystal. Well, that is if there is one to be taken; for now, the threat remains far enough to our east to be out of harm's way.
BAs for you, please have this. Consider it a reward for a job well done, $N.

4861.name: Enraged Wildkin
desc: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.
objectives: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.
details: Hey there, $Glad:lass;! I was chased from my camp in southern Winterspring by some bloodthirsty wildkin! Well, I suppose I got too close to something the wildkin were guarding.

BI barely managed to get away safely; I fear a buddy of mine wasn't as lucky. Would you mind braving the wildkin and heading to the camp? I really need my supplies, and I'd also like to get back the amulet I unearthed yesterday at the dig site.
completion: A severely damaged crate stands out among the rest of the destroyed belongings at the camp...

4981.name: Operative Bijou
desc: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.
details: Never trust a goblin. That's what it comes down to, $N.

BBijou is her name - one of our slipperiest operatives. I found out she was working for some shady exotic pet dealer out of the Burning Steppes named Kibler, in essence, two timing us. Worse yet, she was using Horde funds to finance her operations.
BI want her brought back here alive.
BShe was last seen entering Blackrock Spire. Find her and bring her back.
BAnd $N, do not let her sweet talk you.
completion: I won't lie to you, $R. I needed the money! Kibler pays very, very well - much better than the K.E.F. ever could.

BBut don't doubt my loyalties! Why do you think I'm down here? To get that crazy goblin some exotic animal eggs or something equally inane? No, only someone truly daft would come to Blackrock Spire to collect pets. Yep, I don't reckon too many people like that exist in this world.
B<Bijou laughs.>
BThe last thing we need are those kinds of people breeding.

5125.name: Aurius' Reckoning
completion: $N, I am dying... but my soul is saved. For that, I owe you more than words can say. Please, take this... and fight on, brave $C!

5149.name: Pamela's Doll
desc: Find Pamela's doll.
objectives: Find Pamela's doll.
details: My auntie Marlene told me to stay here in our house because my father had to go and fight. My father's the bravest man in the whole world!
BBut I've been here for a long time, and he hasn't come for me. Sometimes bad people come and whisper to me and I want my dad to make them go away, but he's not here!
BAnd sometimes when it gets dark I want to play with my doll but I can't because I left it in town.
BWill you find my doll for me?
completion: You found it! You found my doll! Oh, thank you!

5245.name: Troubled Spirits of Kel'Theril
desc: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Use Jaron's Pick to find the four Highborne Relic Fragments. Bring them to Aurora Skycaller in Eastern Plaguelands.
details: The highborne spirits are miserable creatures, that's for sure. They are still searching for pieces of the very thing that has cursed them to Kel'Theril forever -- the stolen relic.
BIf you are that interested, take my pick and go south to the lake, see if you can gather the pieces of it from within the ice.
BNow, I can't tell you a thing about what you find, but I do know of someone who might... Aurora Skycaller; she dwells near the Northpass Tower in the northern part of Eastern Plaguelands.
