completion: The past of the high elves is something that I do not wish to discuss, $N. Please, it pains me to think of all that has happened... And that there is no way to make things right.

5341.name: Barov Family Fortune
desc: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.
objectives: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.
details: Within the Scholomance lays the Barov family fortune. I, Alexi Barov, am one of the last two remaining heirs of the house Barov. My brother, Weldon, is the other.
BWeldon, the miserable coward, fled during the war and thus retained his worthless existence as a human.
BHe now searches for the deeds so that he may claim the fortune for his own. Recover the deeds before my brother does and I shall make you wealthy beyond your wildest dreams!
completion: Excellent work, $R. Now to secure my inheritance...

5461.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
desc: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.
objectives: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.
details: The undead fear life just as the living fear death. It is not unusual for a sentient undead being to completely destroy all remnants of his or her previous life after having turned.
BUnfortunately, in order to create an artifact capable of reverting Ras Frostwhisper to a mortal, we must have a keepsake from his years among the living.
BYou must venture to the ruined city of Stromgarde, Frostwhisper's home, and search for such an item. May luck be with you, $N.
completion: I had doubted the possibility of such an item existing. This certainly opens up an incredible opportunity - one we must not squander.
BPrepare yourself, $N, for what I am about to ask of you will take you into the depths of hell.

5533.name: Scholomance
desc: Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Speak with Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.
details: On the island of Caer Darrow lies Scholomance - a wretched center of Scourge necromancy and evil. Our enemy dwells within, conducting unspeakable acts of depravity on unwitting victims... at least, we surmise as much. A door bars the way, and try as we might no entry is to be had without a proper key.
BAlchemist Arbington is well versed on Scholomance, and has an idea how to obtain a key. You have proved your worth to me, and now I entrust this task to you. Speak with him on this matter.
completion: Well met, $C. I've dedicated a fair portion of my recent studies to the Scholomance, and I believe I know a means by which you can acquire a key... one that will let you past the front door.
BI can only imagine what horrid sights are to be seen inside, $N. I don't know how you heroic types do it sometimes...

5581.name: Portals of the Legion
desc: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.
objectives: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.
details: Behold - the Hand of Iruxos. A gruesome sight indeed.

BYou must possess it if the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven are to be banished... which is what I now ask you to do. The Demon threat is increasing and we must close these portals to stem the tide of demons to this world. Good luck, $N... and be wary of the portal guardians.
completion: You are to be commended, $N. Your effort has helped greatly in fighting the demon threat, and all of Azeroth is safer because of it.

5629.name: Returning Home
desc: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
details: Hello again, $N. I know you've been busy aiding our people, but you must take some time for yourself also. Priestess Alathea sent someone here looking for you. It seems that you've caught the attention of our elders and they feel you are prepared for greater things. Head to the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus and look for Alathea there. She will be waiting. Good luck, and may Elune be with you.
completion: Wonderful, you've returned home, $N. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

5677.name: Arcane Feedback
desc: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
details: As much as I'd like to show you our own special teachings of the Light, it is not our place. Your place is back in Stormwind with your own kind, $N... for now. Believe me, I mean no offense. When you return to High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light you'll understand what I'm talking about--the time has come for your race to prepare you for the future; to separate yourself from others that follow a similar path.
completion: We were forced to learn some magics to protect us from what is commonly called our greatest enemy: the arcane.
BI would teach you a spell to help you defend yourself and your companions from those who would wield such power.

5725.name: The Power to Destroy...
desc: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.
objectives: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Varimathras in Undercity.
details: Many denizens of the Legion bestow gifts on their followers as you may well know. Some of these gifts the Dark Lady feels would be better off in her hands than in the hands of those with... lesser vision.

BA sect of the Shadow Council hidden in caverns below Orgrimmar known as the Searing Blade are a prime example. The Lady tells me that members of the Searing Blade have come into the possession of two powerful spell books--she would like to "borrow" these books from them. You will get them for her.
completion: Good, $C. You have done well in serving the Dark Lady. Your continued perseverance and ambition will be of great use to the Lady's subjects. Return to me again in the future. Perhaps I will have other tasks for you that will aid the Dark Lady in her attempts at overtaking the Lich King and completely freeing the Scourge.

5821.name: Bodyguard for Hire
desc: Escort the Gizelton Caravan past the Kolkar Centaur village. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
objectives: Escort the Gizelton Caravan past the Kolkar Centaur village. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.
details: Under normal circumstances, Rigger and I would lead our kodo past the Kolkar Centaur. Every now and then we hear the Centaur war drums, and when we hear those we stop. It's not good for business to be dead!
BI'll tell you what $c, if you protect us past the Kolkar village we'll make it worth your while.
BIt's just a short distance, all you need to do is keep the caravan intact and you can pick up your reward from Smeed Scrabblescrew - he is down the road a bit. We do a little business together.
completion: You know, it doesn't seem prosperous to be paying the likes of you to guard Gizelton Caravan. $C, if I were a bit taller I could take on a second job and sit kodo-side-saddle with the biggest gun my hands could carry... and I'd show them blasted centaur who's their papa.

5845.name: Of Lost Honor
desc: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
objectives: Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
details: The Order of the Silver Hand was utterly decimated when Uther was slain.
BThe boy held out for as long as he could. Pushed to the war torn hamlet of Northdale, he made his final stand.
BWere any of the Order left alive, he thought - and did it matter?
BIt was with that thought that Taelan threw down the standard of the Order and renounced all that he had known. His honor left upon the blood soaked ground of Northdale.
BYou must travel to Northdale and recover that symbol of lost honor.
completion: It is as glorious now - even in its tattered state - as the day I looked upon it and took my oath of allegiance.
BHis redemption comes and perhaps mine with it...

5941.name: Return to Chromie
desc: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.
objectives: Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.
details: You have gathered many relics of the battle of Darrowshire. Each time you returned with more, my heart yearned for my village... yearned to protect it from its fate.
BI know that cannot be, but Chromie, that strange gnome in Andorhal, tells me it is possible. She says you can save Darrowshire!
BShe asked me to gather together the relics, and to have you bring them to her. She said that she awaits you in the ruined inn of Andorhal.
completion: Ah yes, there they are. Together they weave a powerful spell, one that will raise the spirits of Darrowshire.
BWith that spell, and with a little luck, we can save Joseph Redpath!

6061.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Adult Plainstrider. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
details: As a tauren, it is important to follow the traditions of our ancestors by fighting mighty creatures. By besting these creatures, we are able to intake their spirits, allowing us to become closer to the Earthmother.

BIn the same way, taming a beast to fight alongside us helps us become one with nature around us. Eventually, you will learn to tame a beast of your choosing. But all things take practice, and you have much to learn. Begin by taking this taming rod; you must tame an adult plainstrider.
completion: Signs have appeared to me from the Earthmother; you have done well.

6085.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ice Claw Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ice Claw Bear. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Grif Wildheart in Kharanos.
details: Perhaps you'd like a creature that possesses little more than brute strength. The ice claw bear is an excellent companion for a fledgling hunter like yourself, and can be found east of Kharanos. Here is the taming rod; try this animal as a pet and see if ya like it!

BWhen you return, I'll give ya the skills you will need to tame an animal of your choosing; this creature will face the challenges you face, and gain experience alongside you. I will also show you how to call it and dismiss it as ya like.$B
completion: Here you are, $N. I will now give ya the power to tame a beast, as well as call it and dismiss it as you please.
BFind yerself a good, loyal pet, and enjoy the hunt!

6133.name: The Ranger Lord's Behest
desc: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.
You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.
objectives: Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge.
BYou must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.
details: The high elves of the Quel'Lithien lodge possesses something that belongs to me, $c: A document detailing my life as a mortal.
BBefore you ask; no, you most certainly are not privy to such information. Just do as I tell you, worm: Recover the registry.
BAnd imbecile, be sure to leave as much strife and grief as possible in your wake. Leave them suffering...
completion: I trust you did not read the registry. Not even you would do something that idiotic...

6181.name: A Swift Message
desc: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.
objectives: Bring Lewis' Note to Thor the gryphon master.
details: Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor. His name is Osric Strang. His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.
BOur supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more. Can you take him this note?
BThe fastest way to Stormwind is through Thor, our gryphon master. He's just down the hill; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.
completion: You have to get this note to Stormwind? That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!

6301.name: Cycle of Rebirth
desc: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.
objectives: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.
details: Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.
B$N, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.
BOnce you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
completion: Ah? $N, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and you shall see the power that these seeds will do for the land. Only those pure and true can heal the land?
B<Tammra begins to chant.>

6421.name: Boulderslide Ravine
desc: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.
objectives: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.
details: Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, $N?

BSoutheast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave. I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.
BGo young $c, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
completion: Ah... Yes! That's it; the Resonite crystals have a trace of Earthen magic. The Kobolds must have dug deep uncovering an Earthen.
BLegend states that the Earthen are creatures created by the Titans. They were used to create the land our feet walk on. This most definitely is a threat that cannot be ignored.
B<Mor'rogal shakes his head.>
BPerhaps I can enchant these ore samples to use against this Kobold plot.

6541.name: Report to Kadrak
desc: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.
objectives: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.
details: Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.
BIf you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
completion: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.

6565.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
desc: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
objectives: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.
details: This Twilight's Hammer follower cannot be allowed to complete his plan. The Twilight's Hammer do not understand the spirits of nature. They believe in the Old Gods--creatures of chaos and destruction that were long ago defeated. This Lorgus cannot be allowed to succeed. You must stop him, $N. I cannot do it myself--I am too weak.
BGo into Blackfathom Deeps, find him, and kill him. Return to me here at Zoram'gar when it's done.
completion: Very good!! Thank you, $N. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.
BWho knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.

6661.name: Deeprun Rat Roundup
desc: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.
objectives: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.
details: Avast ye scallywag. Arrrr... Arrrr ye looking fer work? We gots a serious rat problem down here an' not enough hands on the poop deck.
BWhat do ye say? All ye needs to do is take this here rat catchin' flute and play the melody around the vermin. They'll follow ye to the ends of the world!
BJust capture five of the little buggers and bring em back here. We needs em alive.
BArrrrr...
completion: These'll werk nicely, matey. Me brother needs em still tickin' and kickin,' else they go sour... Ye don't want to taste no sour rat kabob.

6805.name: Stormers and Rumblers
desc: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
objectives: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumblers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.
details: We, the elementals of water, wage war with those beings of the lesser elements. If you are truly our ally in this conflict, then show me your conviction!

BFar to the south, in the desert land of Silithus, the servants of air and earth scurry in a corner of rock named the Crystal Vale. They protect items of power from smaller beings, mortals, and although I do not know why they do this, I wish to foil their efforts.
BGo to the Crystal Vale in Silithus and defeat our enemies, then return to me.
completion: Your bravery is proven, as is your worth to us. Perhaps I may have future tasks for you, tasks more befitting a valued ally of the Waterlords.

7021.name: Great-father Winter is Here!
desc: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Orgrimmar.
details: Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend! Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter, who's currently in Orgrimmar! If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil. Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!

BAlso, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year. We have a great selection to choose from. Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
completion: Ho ho hello. I am Greatfather Winter, and I - courtesy of the fine folks of Smokywood Pastures... "Fresh from our farm to your plate, it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness" - would like to wish you a fantastic Feast of Winter Veil.
BIf you've been good this year, maybe you will receive treats from Smokywood Pastures as your treat for the Feast of Winter Veil. Huzzah.

7045.name: A Smokywood Pastures Thank You!
desc: Speak with Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak with Greatfather Winter in Ironforge.
details: We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, $N. For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... presented by none other than Greatfather Winter himself!

BPlease, speak with Greatfather Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures. From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... thanks to you, of course!
completion: Ho ho hello, adventurer!

BThe goblins told me that you have earned a special gift this holiday season, and I am pleased to give it to you. Here you go - have a wondrous Feast of Winter Veil this and every season in the future.

7141.name: The Battle of Alterac
desc: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.
details: The Explorers' League believes there are artifacts in Alterac Valley, but the Frostwolf orcs won't let us explore. We can't allow the Horde to stop our scholarly pursuits! Defeat the Frostwolf general, Drek'Thar. With him dead, the orcs will lose their edge.
BDrek'Thar is in Frostwolf Keep, in the south of Alterac Valley. Vanquish him, and then return to me.
completion: Well done, $N! With the Horde's nose bloodied after the death of their general, we'll have the breathing room we need to explore!

7165.name: Earned Reverence
details: I must know, $N. When you look directly into the eyes of the enemy, do you see fear? Do they now cower in your presence? They must realize that they are defeated!
BYou have earned reverence among the Guard.
BPresent your insignia!
completion: <Warmaster Laggrond roars.>$b$bThey have already begun telling tales of your deeds, soldier. The Stormpike shakes in fear when your name is uttered. Carry on!

7261.name: The Sovereign Imperative
desc: Travel to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.
For the glory of Bronzebeard!
objectives: Travel to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.
BFor the glory of Bronzebeard!
details: We are fighting a brutal battle in the valleys of Alterac. The cannibalistic Winterax trolls attack us from one side and the savage Frostwolf Clan from the other. Both must be exterminated in the name of King Magni Bronzebeard! The taking, culling, and turning of that land is a sovereign and territorial imperative to the kingdom of Ironforge.
BAlas, soldiers do not grow on trees! Report to Lieutenant Haggerdin outside Alterac Valley to begin your tour of duty and honor amongst the Stormpike.
completion: Let's get to work!

7501.name: The Light and How To Swing It
desc: Return the book to its rightful owners.
objectives: Return the book to its rightful owners.
details: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
completion: Excellent work, $R. Should you find any more tomes, do not hesitate to return them to us.
BAs time passes, we tend to change around and even add new rewards for the return of missing tomes.

items.name: The Light and How to Swing It

7621.name: A Warning
completion: $C, you are about to undergo a rigorous series of events which shall test all of your abilities.
BI suggest that you listen to the story that I have to tell.
BBe warned, you must complete this task alone. It is recommended that your allies remain at a distance. Interference by outside agents will result in a most severe punishment.
BDestiny has led you and you alone here. Battle with honor. Harness the Light.

7645.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
desc: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
You also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.
objectives: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
BYou also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.
details: The Silver Hand thought me MAD when I told them that I could make a special horse feed that could nourish spiritual horses. EVERYONE thought I was mad! Well, now it's payback time!

BI'll make what you need, PALADIN... so-called CHAMPION... but it will cost you. I need special biscuits - Enriched Manna Biscuits sold only by the Argent Dawn - for this blend. I also demand, yes DEMAND gold as compensation for the misery I have endured!
BShow me the sacrifice you tout so much, PALADIN.
completion: YES, NOW WHO - wait - you're giving me the gold too? You weren't the one who called me mad (actually they called me a fruitcake nut-job)... still, you're willing to show sacrifice even for wrongs you've not committed?
BI... I misjudged you, $N. Should you need more horse feed, come see me. I will give it to you free of charge. Thank you... noble $C.
BI am going to keep the money though - I'm not that much of a nut-job as to give up a fortune.

7789.name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers
desc: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
details: The wilds of the Ashenvale forest will succumb to the might of the Horde, $r. Nothing the Silverwing say or do can stop our sovereign imperative. Kalimdor belongs to the Horde. How dare they attempt to prevent us from harvesting what is rightfully ours!

BLet the pride swell in your chest as you cut down their weak attempts at slowing our progress. Destroy the Silverwing Sentinels, and earn a Warsong mark of honor. Return to me with such a mark, $N, and you will be rewarded.$B
completion: <Captain Shatterskull roars in triumph.>
BHow much more can they withstand? How many more Alliance filth must perish at the hands of the Horde for them to retreat? Only time will tell, $R...

7813.name: A Donation of Wool
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7861.name: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
desc: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.
Vile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.
objectives: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.
BVile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.
details: By order of Primal Torntusk, Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions are to be brought to justice!
BA grand reward is offered for any that slay the Vile Priestess Hexx and all of her Aman'zasi elite guard.
completion: A crippling blow to the Vilebranch, indeed. You shall be richly rewarded, $N.

8053.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Armguards
desc: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker Primal Hakkari Bindings. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: You are a heathen. Heathens have a place in the tribe. Heathens are freethinkers of Zandalar. Freethinkers do not fear oppression. Freethinkers die for what they believe in. We know you would die for what you believe in. This earns our acknowledgement. This earns you a chance to prove yourself further.
BWe must have the Paragons of Power. Go to Zul'Gurub. Kill the minions of Hakkar. Return when you have what I seek. Claim the first battle gear of a Zandalar freethinker.
BGo.
completion: You do much to honor us. Your hands drip with the blood of Hakkar's minions. You are a friend to the tribe.
BWear these bracers. They are the freethinker's armguards. This is what I mean about real power.

8077.name: Paragons of Power: The Demoniac's Robes
desc: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Al'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Kossack. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: The ultimate symbol of power amongst the tribe is the garb we wear in battle. A demoniac's robes have fused fine runecloth and devastatingly powerful mojo into a single fabric. The visage of the robe is said to instill fear into the minds of all who see it... especially the demons that the demoniac will eventually dominate.
BFrom Zul'Gurub, you must bring me a very specific set of the Paragons of Power. It will be difficult... but your success will assure you of acquiring a robe for yourself.
completion: Impressive - your victory in Zul'Gurub has assured us - nay, the world - that Hakkar will not prevail. The time may come when you face the Blood God directly... and should this come to pass know that your reverence is assured amongst the Zandalar tribe.
BOh, and this simple robe should help out too I think.
B<Al'tabim winks knowingly at you.>

8101.name: The Pebble of Kajaro
completion: $R, the pebble held within the frame of this talisman comes from Mount Kajaro in the South Seas. Mount Kajaro is an area plagued by volatility - marked by violent and oftentimes magical volcanic eruptions.
BAs your bond with the trolls of Zandalar grows, so too shall the power of this pebble. Harness the power of the pebble to strike down our enemies. Be like the mountain: Quick, explosive, deadly...

8149.name: Honoring a Hero
desc: Travel to Uther's Tomb in Western Plaguelands and use Uther's Tribute at his statue, and then return to Wagner Hammerstrike outside Ironforge before the Harvest Festival is over.
objectives: Travel to Uther's Tomb in Western Plaguelands and use Uther's Tribute at his statue, and then return to Wagner Hammerstrike outside Ironforge before the Harvest Festival is over.
details: During the Harvest Festival of Azeroth, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf. The Alliance acknowledges many heroes, but none weave a more tragic tale than that of Uther Lightbringer.

BHelp us honor Uther by taking this offering to his tomb in the Western Plaguelands. Place it at his statue, and then return to me. I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Uther his tribute.
completion: He was a hero among heroes, Uther was. I can't even begin to imagine the anguish of what he felt when Arthas - his greatest student and someone whom Uther loved like his own son - betrayed all of humanity. Still, he rose to try and stop Arthas, and for that he will be forever remembered as a true paladin. His fight was to the end, thinking only of those he might save.
BThank you, $N. You've paid tribute to a great hero today, honoring his spirit and the spirit of the Harvest Festival.

8317.name: Kitchen Assistance
desc: Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings.
objectives: Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings.
details: That recipe sure will come in handy. I'd better get to work so I can have some smoked desert dumplings ready for today. I could use a hand in making some, I'll make it worth your while.
completion: Excellent! You're a life saver. These dumplings turned out to be quite good. Didn't really expect such good taste from the Twilight's Hammer.

8341.name: Lords of the Council
desc: Bring 5 Large Brilliant Shards and 3 Abyssal Signets to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
objectives: Bring 5 Large Brilliant Shards and 3 Abyssal Signets to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
details: Lords of the Abyssal Council can only be summoned through the greater wind stones, and only the top ranking members of the Twilight's Council may speak to them. But... I have found a way to upgrade your disguise and fool the Abyssal Lords!
BThe disguise calls for a ring of lordship, worn only by the highest members of the cult. I will craft one for you if you can bring me large brilliant shards and abyssal signets.
completion: Thanks. Just one moment and I'll have that ring ready for you...
BThere it is. Now you're ready.

BBe sure to wear this ring, along with a medallion of station and the rest of the twilight trappings, when you activate a greater wind stone. Do that, and the Abyssal Council will think you one of their servants. Then, perhaps you can lure one into an ambush!

8365.name: Pirate Hats Ahoy!
desc: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
objectives: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
details: You're the help the Cartel sent? I suppose you'll do. Listen carefully $c. As you know, I am a procurer of fashionable apparel for the elite of Azerothian society. Kings and Queens, Warchiefs and, well whatever the Horde calls their queens, all wear what I choose is in style. And they pay through the nose for it, which is the best part.
BSo here's what's going to happen. You head down to Lost Rigger Cove and acquire a lot of pirate hats by whatever means. Do you think you can handle that?
completion: Oh you're a darling, even if it did take you longer than I am accustomed to. This shipment should make me quite a bit of money once I've cleaned and personalized these hats. And seeing as I'm always willing to reward work that's well done, here's a little something for you. I suggest that you spend some of it on a bath sweetie.

8413.name: Da Voodoo
desc: Bring the voodoo feathers to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
objectives: Bring the voodoo feathers to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
details: The spirit totem just isn't enough. We be needin' some voodoo magic to make it work jus' right.
BThe trolls in the sunken temple have feathers strong with voodoo magics. Go there and kill Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Then we have magic enough for a real spirit totem.
completion: It's about time this troll got a full night's rest! The spirit totem will watch over me.
BI been a long time collectin' things, maybe you want somethin' for all your trouble?

8437.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war. No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.

BThe battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple. Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going. Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $N!
completion: Securing our resources in Arathi is an important task! You've done well, $N.

8461.name: Deadwood of the North
desc: Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
objectives: Nafien would like you to kill 6 Deadwood Den Watchers, 6 Deadwood Avengers, and 6 Deadwood Shamans. Return to him in northern Felwood near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
details: There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest. Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem.

BThe Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds. Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped. It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren.
BPlease, $N - I ask you to do what must be done. Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.
completion: I sense that you have achieved victory. Victory... such a hollow word considering what had to be done. Regardless, you've proven yourself to be worthy of our trust.

BIt may take some time before the Timbermaw welcome you without hostility within the Hold. Still, your perseverance will erode any suspicion my brethren may have about you. So long as you never betray us and raise weapons against us, we will find common ground.

8485.name: The Brokering of Peace
desc: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring the Timbermaw Offering of Peace to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
details: Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, $N. If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with.

BPlease - take this offering to the orcish warchief that resides in the lands of Durotar; I believe you call this city Orgrimmar. In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Horde. It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Horde's efforts in brokering peace.
completion: Indeed, this is a most fortuitous turn of events. Were a lasting peace to be made with these creatures, this would certainly give us an advantage in securing Kalimdor from external threats. I will notify the other leaders of the Horde of this immediately, and further diplomats will be dispatched!
BAs for you, $N... you have shown courage in both diplomacy and in action. I thank you, as does the entirety of the Horde.

8509.name: The Alliance Needs Arthas' Tears!
desc: Bring 20 Arthas' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring 20 Arthas' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
details: I'll keep it simple and to the point, $c. The Alliance needs to collect a large quantity of Arthas' Tears for the Ahn'Qiraj war effort. Don't ask me what for; I'm just following orders. But I'd like you to gather up as many of the herbs as you can and bring them back to me here. Are you willing to do that?
completion: Good work, $C. I must say that I'm pleasantly surprised. You would not believe the number of people that have come by, offering to help, but never returning. Let me just get those into a crate and tallied with your name on it, and then we can talk again about whether I need anymore of those plants.

8533.name: The Horde Needs More Copper Bars!

8557.name: Drape of Unyielding Strength
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Martial Drape, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Keyl Swiftclaw in Silithus. You must also obtain Revered reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, $N. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, $c.
BI shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp.
BI promise you won't be disappointed.
completion: Ah yes... this drape is immaculate.
BTake this cloak, $N. May it protect you from the foul magic of the Qiraji.

8605.name: The Horde Needs More Wool Bandages!

8653.name: Goldwell the Elder
completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

8677.name: Darkhorn the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $c. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8701.name: Band of Veiled Shadows
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Onyx Idols, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.
BThe gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.
BBring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $c.
completion: I will swap the gem on the ring for you. You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.

8725.name: Riversong the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8749.name: The Path of the Protector

objectives.target: Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight

completion: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, $n. May you never stray from the path of the protector!

8797.name: The Alliance Needs Your Help!
desc: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
objectives: Speak with Field Marshal Snowfall in Ironforge's Military Ward.
details: Hello, I'm glad that you've decided to hear me out. The Alliance needs all of the help that it can get to prepare for the Ahn'Qiraj War, and that means that we need you! Even now as we speak, official collectors are gathering the necessary material needed for the upcoming war, but we won't be able to meet our goals without your assistance, $N!
BYou should go speak with the guy in charge, Field Marshal Snowfall. What do you say, $c? Will you help out with the vital preparations?
completion: NULL

8869.name: Sweet Serenity
desc: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.
objectives: Travel to Stratholme and kill the Crimson Hammersmith. Recover the Crimson Hammersmith's Apron and return to Lilith.
details: Within the confines of the Scarlet Bastion lies sweet Serenity. The Crimson Hammersmith guards the recipe with his life. Defeat him and bring me his apron. For that, I shall train you to become a hammersmith.
BUnderstand this: Once you have chosen the path of the hammersmith, the paths of the swordsmith and axesmith will no longer be available.
completion: NULL

8917.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.$B
details: Hail, $c! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.
BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.
BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
completion: Ah, yes. Mux will be quite happy with this.
BThose bracers were part of a larger armor set. If you're interested in providing me with further assistance, I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.

8941.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring a Shadowcraft Belt and a set of Shadowcraft Gloves to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
details: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $N. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.
BFor now I will exchange your belt and gloves. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
completion: Our agreement remains in place. Just remember, this is but a taste of what awaits you. Free me of this cursed fate and I will reward you with items of truly great power.

8965.name: Components of Importance
desc: Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
objectives: Obtain Soul Ashes of the Banished and return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
details: $C, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade.

BAn ogre necromancer that traveled with us, Kormok, delighted in summoning forth the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle, off the south coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Go there and retrieve some Soul Ashes of the Banished from their remains.
completion: A job well done, $N. I will imbue the essence of the ashes into the brazier.

BNow all that is left is to get into Scholomance, to Ras Frostwhisper's chamber, and use the brazier to summon forth the spirit of my former cohort, Kormok. The amulet piece, and Valthalak's spirit within, has corrupted him even further, and he will not rest until you forcibly take it from him.

8989.name: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
desc: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
objectives: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
details: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.
BLater, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.
completion: Thank you for helping Mor Grayhoof, $N. Another spirit rests in peace, and we now have the reassembled amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
BIn order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

9013.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Mokvar your Helm of Valor and Breastplate of Valor.
objectives: Give Mokvar your Helm of Valor and Breastplate of Valor.
details: A truly amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.
BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
completion: I will truly miss you, $N. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.
BEnjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!

9085.name: Shadows of Doom
desc: Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Go to a summoning circle and kill a Shadow of Doom, then return to Commander Thomas Helleran at Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
details: After you bring down the defenses of the Scourge summoning circles that have appeared in the zones under attack, you will be able to confront the acolytes who protect them.

BIn truth, these are not men. They are shadows, some of the Lich King's most frightening creatures. They can be revealed using the necrotic runes they carry, and then destroyed with magic or strength of arms.
completion: NULL

9229.name: The Fate of Ramaladni
desc: Enter Naxxramas and uncover the Fate of Ramaladni.
objectives: Enter Naxxramas and uncover the Fate of Ramaladni.
details: Ramaladni was a warrior of the Brotherhood - a pupil of Highlord Mograine before the Dawn even existed! When news of Mograine's death reached him, hatred and anger took over.

BUnderstand this, $N, when rage and retribution take the reins, a man ceases to be a man. The man personifies the emotions that control him instead. And so it would be that Ramaladni, the spirit of retribution, would enter Naxxramas to exact vengeance... and never return.
BEnter Naxxramas and find what became of Ramaladni.
completion: It is his ring! But it is destroyed. No other evidence of Ramaladni was found?
B<Korfax grimaces.>
BThis does not bode well for Ramaladni. The ring, however... it might be salvageable.

9301.name: Envelope from the Front
desc: Take the Bloodstained Envelope to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Bloodstained Envelope to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
completion: How tragic. These words, clearly meant for someone the soldier loved, never made it to their destination. The events detailed happened years ago; I'm not sure if the intended recipient still lives.
BThere is hope yet, however. With the names and information he gives, I might be able to locate the family! It will take some research, but the librarian in Stormwind owes me a favor...
BThank you for bringing this to me. With your help, we may be able to grant someone peace of mind at least.

9325.name: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame
desc: Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
objectives: Return the Flame of Thunder Bluff to the Festival Loremaster.
details: This flame, stolen from the shaman of Thunder Bluff, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
completion: Unless I miss my guess, this fire has been taken from the cliffs of Thunder Bluff! How it sings with the power of the spirits! You are quite the thief, $N. Take this as just payment for your skill. Now, if only we had the flames of all three cities...

objectives: Slay 8 Vile Fin Attackers and 8 Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.
* Vile Fin Attacker slain (8)
* Vile Fin Seer slain (8)
details: Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.

objectives: Slay 8 Vuldren Juveniles in Thendal Grove.
* Juvenile Vuldren slain (8)
details: We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.
The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.
Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.

objectives: Read the Folded Parchment then speak with Xyton Silverwind in Thendal Grove.
* Folded Parchment (provided)
details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident druid trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.
Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.

objectives: Obtain 10 Coarse Dynamite from crafting, trading, or the auction house, then return to Sprite Jumpsprocket in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.
*Coarse Dynamite (10)
details: Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...

objectives: Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
*Webbed Forsaken freed (6)
details: If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.
This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
Then they will see our nature.
